panels.panel_visual_description: Character A, a 3D animated female avatar, is framed from the chest up against an abstract, out-of-focus geometric background in shades of blue and purple. She looks directly at the camera with a friendly, static smile. Her head moves slightly as she speaks, but her body remains mostly still. The lighting is even and artificial.

Character B is seated indoors, framed from the waist up. The background features a softly lit room with a wooden console table and a potted plant. She is actively running her hands through her long dark hair, applying oil. She looks up towards the camera occasionally while speaking and smiling. The lighting is warm and natural.
